Command.Name: SetIdle_Timeout
Command.FPOperation: Program device's idle timeout setting. Set timeout for closing the connection if there is an inactivity. Maximal value - 7200, minimal value 1. 0 is for never close the connection. This option can be used only if the device has LAN or WiFi. To apply use - SaveNetworkSettings()

Arg.Name: IdleTimeout
Arg.Desc: 4 symbols for Idle timeout in format ####
